description: Publish a form's draft as its live version in the project `cwd` resolves to. Save the draft first with form_update and `draft: true`; a form with no draft fails with NO_DRAFT. Needs the revisions licence (Security Module).

cwd.description: Optional. Directory whose project to use; defaults to the client's workspace root.

formId.description: The form's _id, a 24-character ObjectId (form_get returns it)

note.description: Revision note describing what the draft changes against the live form (e.g. "Add phone field")

name: form_publish
